entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-10
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • X509CertificateLoader.LoadPkcs12FromFile removes X509Certificate2.FriendlyName #123071
  • [Proposal] Document that Linq-to-XML is thread-safe for multiple readers #123068
  • Inconsistent behavior for CreateTruncating/TryConvertFromTruncating and CreateSaturating/TryConvertFromSaturating with floating-point special values #123066
  • Deabstraction of IReadOnlyList access in a loop can be prevented by inlining #123065
  • ZipArchiveEntry.ExtractToFile corrupt destination files on exception #123059
  • X509Chain.Build fails with NRE when ExtraStore certificates are reused within SslStream RemoteCertificateValidationCallback #123058

Closed

  • Enum.Equals boxes its arguments and is not inlined #122684
    11.0.0
  • [BUG] ChineseLunisolarCalendar.GetDaysInMonth returns incorrect output for the 8th and 9th months of the lunar year 2057 #123069
  • [.NET 6] Binding to non-null `IReadOnlyDictionary` doesn't work #105960
    Future
  • Hard to use `DOTNET_DbgEnableMiniDump` when crossgen is involved somewhere in the build #122982
  • The ResolveReadyToRunCompilers task fails when building for mobile platforms #122985
  • Proposal: ConditionalWeakReference<TKey, TValue> #30759

PullRequests

Created

  • Remove unused SORT_MARK_STACK code. #123063
    area-GC-coreclr
  • Use System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshalling.ComVariant instead of custom VARIANT types in libraries #123060
    area-System.Runtime.InteropServices
  • Fix up hijacking on arm32 (preserve async continuation register) #123057
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr, runtime-async

Merged

  • Restructure copilot-instructions.md to emphasize mandatory baseline build #123067
  • Intrinsify Enum.Equals to avoid boxing #122779
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • [release/9.0] Bump internal MacOS build image to MacOS15 #123070
    Servicing-approved, area-Infrastructure
  • Defer DOTNET_DbgEnableMiniDump error message until dump creation #122986
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr
  • [release/9.0] Move default build images to macos 15 (and xcode 16) (#120589) #122422
    Servicing-approved, area-Infrastructure
  • Fix edge-case Uri debug assert failure #123054
    area-System.Net, 11.0.0

Updated

  • Improve code coverage for System.Security.Cryptography.Xml #120640
    area-System.Security, test-enhancement
  • Add DOTNET_DbgCreateDumpToolPath to override createdump directory (NativeAOT only) #122989
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr
  • Bring throw helpers to PUSH_COOP_PINVOKE_FRAME plan #123015
    area-VM-coreclr, community-contribution
  • [release/8.0] Move default build images to macos 15 (and xcode 16) (#120589) #122423
    Servicing-approved, area-Infrastructure
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #122554
    Servicing-approved, area-codeflow
  • [release/10] Bump MacOS helix queues to latest #122990
    area-Infrastructure
  • [EventPipe] Remove thread lock and cleanup ThreadSessionState lifecycle #118415
    area-Tracing-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • Optimize file system enumeration pattern matching with specialized delegates #123041
    area-System.IO
  • Fix up hijacking on arm64 (preserve async continuation register) #122942
    arch-arm64, area-NativeAOT-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Fix `LoadFromStream` to stop checking/loading from `APP_PATHS` #123049
    area-AssemblyLoader-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • Crossgen2: Support Writing R2R Metadata into Wasm Data Sections in Wasm Object Writer #122878
    area-crossgen2-coreclr
  • Implement support for ExtendedLayoutKind.CUnion #123052
    area-Interop-coreclr
  • [release/10.0] Fix EC-DSA / EC-DH PEM key loading with PKCS#8 key load attributes #123036
    Servicing-consider, area-System.Security, 10.0.x
  • [DRAFT] Generate more CINC #123022
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • [Wasm RyuJit] throw helper / null check preliminaries #123053
    arch-wasm, area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • [Wasm RyuJIT] Implement 8 and 16-bit loads/stores; implement indirect loads/stores #123021
    arch-wasm, area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Update OpenSUSE Helix testing from 15.6 to 16.0 #122371
    needs-area-label
  • [release/9.0-staging] Fix ICustomQueryInterface implementation in CrossApartmentQueryInterface_NoDeadlock #122570
    test-enhancement, area-Interop-coreclr, 9.0.x
  • [clr-interp] Async Resume stubs are exclusive to the JIT as they use a set of intrinsics that are JIT specific #123046
    area-CodeGen-Interpreter-coreclr, runtime-async
  • fix ntlm tests on platforms with broken gssapi #123055
    area-System.Net.Security, 11.0.0
